verification: voltage ranges are not published for this plugin: no public source is available for verification. Corrections and citations are welcome from anyone with access to the source.
comment: There is no source for this plugin. Nothing here takes polyphony: every port is read and written at its first channel only, and no channel count is set on any output. Every clock, reset and trigger jack in the plugin shares one threshold, written once in the shared BaseModule::process — high at 2V, released at 0.1V. Every control voltage jack is added to the knob beside it through its own attenuverter, so what a given voltage does depends on where that attenuverter is set and no range is written for those.
